item.title: Brooklyn Park curler sets record as oldest US Winter Olympian
item.description: Rich Ruohonen's Olympic journey is a testament to dreams realized and records broken.'That moment was unbelievable' Ruohonen, at 54, made his Olympic debut as an alternate for the U.S. men's curling team during their match against Switzerland last week.His participation set a record as the oldest U.S. athlete to compete in the Winter Games."It's been the story of the games. Everybody in the athlete village is like, congrats. I have this shirt that says, ‘I'm not the dad and I'm not the coach,’"
